Text: At last, we have completed all possible research! Your dedication is inspirational, Player. A thousand thousand thanks!
Ahem. Your current progress in cosmic  research is...complete!? Sweet Mother Hydaelyn! Marvelous work!
This star and Etheirys share some startling similarities, from the atmospheric composition to the abundance of flora. I approve, ahem.
Do you not find the architecture here remarkable!? Tens of thousands of years old, and yet the wood stands strong! Genius design, I tell you...
The Cosmic Harvester is a triumph of our unique mech technology. Or so Alerot has informed me. *Extensively*.
This star's towerlings are organic bodies that accumulate vast amounts of information. As for *how* they do this...your guess is as good as mine!
Now that we've dusted the cobwebs off Grandma Laurel, I daresay we're in for some tales that only our elders can provide...
